helpGuidesCatalog.shortTip: Your Home screen keeps cognitive load low: see your overall net position, quick-add any expense (with or without a group), or jump into your 3 most recently active groups.
whereToFindWhat: Top Bar: Net Position across all groups and direct friend splits.
Quick Add Expense: Log a standalone 1-on-1/ad-hoc split (No Group) or assign to any group.
Recent Groups (Max 3): Your 3 most recently accessed or updated groups. Click any group to open its progressive workspace.
Direct Non-Group Splits: Bills split directly between participants without creating a group.

steps.title: Quick-Add a Standalone or Group Bill
steps.description: Click '+ Quick Add Expense' on Home. Leave Group as 'No Group (Direct Split)' to split between specific people, or pick a group.

steps.title: Open a Group for Progressive Insights & Actions
steps.description: Click any of your Top 3 Recent Groups (or 'View All Groups') to unlock group-specific insights, balance explanations, and group settings.

steps.title: Settle Up via UPI QR or WhatsApp Card
steps.description: Open 'Friends & Settle' to clear balances across multiple groups in one atomic batch or generate a UPI QR code.

helpGuidesCatalog.shortTip: Once a group is opened, minimal group-scoped insights appear automatically at the top alongside all group operations (Add Expense with group pre-selected, Explain Balance, Currency Switcher, and Simplify Toggle).
whereToFindWhat: Minimal Group Insights Strip: Total group spend, your personal share, and your net group balance.
Conflict Banner (when applicable): 1-click resolution for concurrent offline edits.
Left Column: Group members, Google OAuth link status, 'Explain Balance' math modal, and suggested repayments.
Right Column: Filterable expense ledger with rotating remainder badges and foreign FX audit notes.

steps.title: Add Expense (Group Pre-Selected)
steps.description: Click 'Add Expense' inside the group header - this group is pre-selected automatically with all 5 split modes.

steps.title: Inspect Mathematical Lineage
steps.description: Click 'Explain' next to any member to view the exact equation (Paid - Share + Sent - Received = Net).

helpGuidesCatalog.pageTitle: Transparent Activity Feed, Revisions & Trash Vault
helpGuidesCatalog.shortTip: Every create, edit, currency change, settlement, and conflict in a group is logged here with HLC timestamps and 1-click restore.
whereToFindWhat: Activity Timeline: Filter by any action type (Expense Edited, Conflict Flagged, Settlement Recorded, etc.).
Revision Inspector: View field-by-field before -> after diffs and restore any historical revision.
Trash Recovery Vault: Restore soft-deleted bills in one click.

helpGuidesCatalog.pageTitle: Cross-Group Friends Net Ledger & UPI/WhatsApp Studio
helpGuidesCatalog.shortTip: See your combined net balance with each friend across all shared groups and direct non-group splits, without mixing strangers across groups.
whereToFindWhat: Friends Net List: Per-group breakdown + 'Settle All Across Groups' atomic batch button.
UPI QR & Deep-Link Studio: Pre-filled upi://pay links and scannable QR code.
WhatsApp Summary Generator: Copy-ready markdown and visual summary card.

helpGuidesCatalog.pageTitle: Deep Spending Analytics & Global Instant Search
helpGuidesCatalog.shortTip: Full visual breakdowns by category and split mode, plus instant search across all groups and currencies.
whereToFindWhat: Category & Split Mode Charts: Proportional SVG ring and bar distributions.
Global Search: Filter by keyword, #tag, currency (INR/JPY/KWD/EUR/USD), or split mode.

helpGuidesCatalog.pageTitle: Local IndexedDB, Supabase Sync & Data Portability
helpGuidesCatalog.shortTip: Manage your local Dexie IndexedDB mirror, Supabase wise_spliter cloud sync, Splitwise CSV imports, and AES-256-GCM encrypted backups.
whereToFindWhat: Cloud Sync Center: Toggle Offline Flight Mode and flush queued outbox mutations to wise_spliter.
Splitwise Importer & CSV/PDF Exporter: Migrate data in or export statements out.
Encrypted Backup Vault: PBKDF2 + AES-256-GCM encrypted .wisesplit backup and restore.
